description: Twaganiriye ivya bamwe 144000 badomweko ikimenyetso.Ikindi Yohana yeretswe ivy'abamalayika bane bahagaze kumfuruka zine z'isi, iyo miyaga rero niyo guca amateka kw'Imana.
name: Abadomweko ikimenyetso

description: Twumvise ivya bamwe 144000 badomweko ikimenyetso kugira ngo baze bazigamwe mu gihe c'amarushwa ahambaye yagira asukwe mw'isi. Yohana yeretswe ibizoba kw'isi ishengero rimaze kuva mw'isi. Abo bantu 144000 bazoba bavuye mu miryango yose y'Ab'Isirayeli nkuko kuva na kera iryo hanga ritegeze riburamwo amasigarira.
name: Abamalayika bane bafashe imiyaga ine yo kw'isi

description: Twaganiriye ivyo Yohana yeretswe kuvy'inzavya z'uburake bw'imana yabonye abamalayika bafise izo nzavya bazisuka mw'isi hanyuma haca haba ivyago bikomeye cane. Ivyo rero nivyo vyago bizoba mu mpera ya ca gihe c'amarushwa kizoba ishengero ry'Umwami rimaze kuva mw'isi. Bizoba ari ivyago vyanyuma Umwami yesu azorekurira ku bansi biwe bo mw'isi imbere yuko agaruka gushinga ubwami bwiwe bw'amahoro,hahigwa abazoba muri ubwo bwami kandi bakaba kure y'iki gihe c'amarushwa.
name: Abamalayika basuka ivyago mw'isi

description: Twabonye ivyo guhishurwa kwa Yesu Kristo no gushinga intahe kwiwe. Ikindi twumvise nuko hari imigisha yasezeraniwe abasoma n'abasomerwa kino gitabu.
name: Gushinga intahe

description: Yohana ari muri Mpwemu Year, yabonye urugi rwama rwuguruye; yabonye Intebe nini year hamwe n'izindi ntebe 24 ziyikikuje. Yabonye ibinyabugingo 4 bifise amababa 6 bifise amaso.
name: Ibihambaye Yohana yeretswe

description: Twabonye Yohana yerekwa ibikoko bibiri. Ivyo bikoko biratwereka ukuntu antikristo azoba afise ububasha bukomeye mw'isi muri ca gihe c'amarushwa menshi azoba ishengero rimaze kuva mw'isi.
name: Ibikoko bibiri Yohana yeretswe

description: Ubuheruka twaganiriye kuri vya binyabugingo Yohana yabona bikikije intebe y'Imana. Twaraganiriye kandi ku gitabo cari gifiswe niyivyagiye kuri ya ntebe.
name: Ibinyabugingo bihimbaza Iyivyagiye kuri ya Ntebe.

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyo Yohana yeretswe vy'inzavya ndwi n'ivyago ndwi bizorangiza igihe c'amarushwa ahambaye. Twarabonye yuko ivyo bizoba imbere yuko vya vyago vyanyuma bisukwa mw'isi.
name: Ibizoba imbere y'ivyago Yohana Yeretswe

description: Mu kiganiro cacu giheruka, twarihweje ibizoba igihe c'inyuma y'amarushwa ico gihe kikazoza ishengero rimaze kuva mw'isi. Inyuma yayo marushwa twabonye ko ariho Yesu azoza gushinga ubwami bwiwe bw'imyaka 1000, azoza mu mubwiza bwiwe n'ububasha bukomeye. Azobanza kwiganzura abansi biwe, abone gushinga ubwami bwiwe bw'amahoro , hahirwa abazobana nawe.
name: Ibizoba inyuma y'amarushwa akomeye

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'igikoko ca mbere Yohana yeretswe akabona ciburutse mu kiyaga, yabonye gifise ishusho y'ingwe ahandi kikamera nk'idubu ahandi naho nk'intambwe. Ico gikoko rero cabonetse gifise ububasha n'ubwenge bukomeye kigakora n'ibitangaza n'ibimenyetso kandi gihabwa kuganza amahanga yose yo mw'isi. Ariko rero cahawe akanwa kavuga ibihambaye n'ivyo kurogota mbere ngo gihabwa kugwanya abera no kubanesha. ivyo rero n'ibizoba ku ngoma ya antikristo kandi muri ico gihe abera b'Imana bazokwicwa ariko abandi bazosenga ico gikoko.
name: Igikoko kivuga ibihambaye

description: Twaganiriye kuvya wa mugore n'igisato c'amahero Yohana yeretswe. Uwo mugore twarumvise ko ari ihanga rya Isirayeli, ico gisato naco ko ari satani. Ico gisato rero caragerageje uburyo bwose bwo kurotsa umwana w'uwo mugore mugabo ntivyakunze. Twarihweje kandi ukuntu satani yateye intambara mw'ijuru mugabo akaneshwa na malayika mukuru. Mbere ico gisato caciye gikororerwa mw'isi hamwe n'abamalayika baco. Ico kiyoka kimaze gukorogwa cagumye gihiga wa mugore kimufitiye inzigo nyinshi mugabo nticamuronse.
name: Igisato c'amahero n'inzigo yaco

description: Twihweje ikete Umwami Yesu yandikiye ishengero ryo muri Efeso. Ikindi twabonye n'impanuro zahawe iryo shengero hamwe n'impera Yesu abikiwe abihanganye gushika kw'iherezo.
name: Impanuro zahawe abo muri Efeso

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvy'ukugaruka kwa Kristo aho azoba aje gushinga ubwami bwiwe bw'imyaka 1000. Twarumvise ko iyo myaka yose satani azoyimara aboshwe, abohewe ikuzimu hanyuma akarekugwa ngo amare igihe gito azimiza amahanga yo mu mpande zine z'isi. Azokoraniriza abami bayo mahanga kugwanya ingabo z'abera b'Imana ariko ayo mahanga azotikizwa n'umuriro w'Imana . Satani azoca atererwa mu kiyaga caka umuriro n'amazuku asangeyo antikristo na wa muvugishwa wiwe w'ibinyoma. Munyuma abapfuye bazozuka abahambaye n'aboroshe barengutswe imbere y'intebe niniya yera ya Kristo kugira ngo bacirigwe urubanza rw'ivyaha vyabo.
name: Ingaruka z'ubugarariji

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira ivy'ijuru risha n'isi nsha na cane cane umugwa wera ariwo Yerusalemu mushasha nkuko Yohana yavyeretswe . Twarumvise yuko aho hantu ariho Imana yateguriye abayizeye kuigira ngo baze babane nayo ibihe bitazoshira, bazokwama mu munezero kandi nta kintu kibabaza bazosubira kubona( Ivyah 21: 4 ) Aho hantu hameze neza gutyo ni kuri wa mugwa Yerusalemu musha.Uwo mugwa rero wateguriwe abana b'Imana aribo bamana inzara n'inyota vyo kugororoka.
name: Ingene abazoba ku mugwa bazoba bameze

description: Twihweje ubuhanuzi bwo gukomvomvogwa kw'I Babuloni nk'uko twabibonye mu gitabu c'Ivyahishuriwe Yohana igice ca 18. Ico gisagara kizokomvomvoka giciriwe kw'iteka n'Imana. Mu gihe c'antikristo ico gisagara kizoba gihambaye cane kiganza isi yose niconyene kizoba ndetse ari umugwa mukuru w'antikristo. ico gisagara kandi ntikizoba gihowe ubusa kuko nico catanguwemwo ubugarariji bwo gusenga ibigigwamana kuva na kera narindi bitayeko abantu b'Imana bahiciwe nibenshi kandi mu gihe c'antikristo hoho bizorushiriza.
name: Ingene I Babuloni hazobona ibara

description: Twihweje ingene Yesu yiyeretse Yohana ari mu kizinga ca Patimo kandi akamutegeka kwandika ivyo abonye nivyo yumvise.
name: Ingene Umwami Yesu yiyeretse Yohana

description: Twabiye hamwe ibizoba muri ca kabiri ca ca gihe c'amarushwa kizoza ishengero rimaze kuva mw'isi. Twarumvise ukuntu isi izobona ibara igihe umumalayika agira gatandatu azovuza inzamba yiwe nk'uko Yohana yavyeretswe.
name: Ingorane zizoshikira abatizera

description: Twaganiriye ivy'intambara Yohana yeretswe aho satani yateye intambara mw'ijuru mugabo akaneshwa na malayika Mikayeli mukuru ( Ivyahishuriwe Yohana 12:7)
name: Intambara hagati y'abamalayika b'Imana n'aba satani

description: Twaganiriye kw'ijambo ry'intangamarara y'igitabo c'ubuhanuzi bw'Ivyahishuriwe Yohana. Twarumvise ko ari igitabo gihambaye cane dusanga muri Bibiliya kuko kitwereka iherezo ry'ibiri mw'isi. Ikinditwumvise nuko ico gitabo giteye ubwoba kuri abo bose batubaha Imana kuko bazogira iherezo ribi.
name: Intangamarara y'ico gitabo

description: Twaganiriye kw'ijambo ry'intangamarara y'igice ca gatandatu c'igitabo c'ivyahishuriwe Yohana Twarumvise yuko ivyanditswe muri ico gice ari ivyo Yohana yeretswe mugabo ari ibizoba hanyuma.Ivyo bizoba igihe ishengero ry'Imana rizoba rimaze kuva mw'isi.
name: Intangamarara y'igice ca 6

description: Twize kuvy'abamalayika Yohana yeretswe bafise inzavya zuzuyemwo uburake bw'Imana bakazisuka mw'isi hagaca haba ivyago vy'agahebuza. Twarumvise yuko ivyo vyago ari ibizoba bivuye k'Umwami Yesu Kristo vyo gucira urubanza abansi biwe bamugararije mw'isi.
name: Ivy'abamalayika batatu bakurikira

description: Yohana yeretws abamalayika indwi; yabonye bahabwa inzamba ndwi ngo bazivuze. Uko bazivuza, niko haboneka icago kandi hari n'amajambo yagiye avugwa.
name: Ivy'abamalayika indwi

description: Ubuheruka twaganiriye kuvy'abantu babiri Yohana yeretswe bashingiye intahe Imana. Yabonye abo bantu babiri bavugishwa n'Imana bafise ububasha bwokwivuna uwo wese agomvye kubagirira nabi akicwa n'umuriro kandi babonetse bafise ububasha ku mazi kuyahindura amaraso, no kubabarisha isi icago cose uko bagomvye.
name: Ivy'abantu babiri

description: Twaganiriye ku vya wa mumalayika w'inkomezi Yohana yerekwa akabona afise agatabo mu minwe. Twarumvise kandi n'ingene Yohana yahawe irenga rimeze nk'inkoni akabwibwa kugera urusengero rw'Imana, igicaniro hamwe n'abarusengeramwo. Twaribukijwe yuko iyo habaye kugera nk'uko haba himirije gushika ivyago kub'Isirayeli bivuye ku burake bw'Imana.
name: Ivy'agatabo kazinguruye

description: Twashimikiye kw'ishengero rinini ry'abacunguwe Yohana yeretswe bari mw'ijuru. Yabonye bahagaze imbere y'intebe y'Imana bambaye imvune zera bafise amashami y'ibigazi basemerera n'ijwi rirenga bati agakiza n'ak'umwagazi w'intama w'Imana eka mbere n'abamalayika bose yabonye bahagaze bakikije ino ntebe bakikije na ba bakuru na vya binyabugingo bikubita hasi basenga Imana.
name: Ivy'imiryango y'abadomwe kw'ikimenyetso

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvya maraya n'igikoko gisa n'agahama ivyo Yohana yeretswe. Twarumvise ko ishengero ry'Imana rimaze kuva mw'isi hazosigara ishengero maraya rigizwe n'abazoba basigaye mw'isi batetye ibitugu Kristo Umwami wacu. Amaherezo y'iryo shengero rero ritaryo nayo n'ukurandugwa kandi rizorandugwa n'antikristo n'abandi bami bazoba bafatanije nawe. Muri ukwo kurandugwa hari ibisagara bikomeye bizobona ibara ari vyo Babuloni ni Roma.
name: Ivy'imisozi ndwi Yohana yabonye

description: Twaganiriye kuri za nzige Yohana yerekwa akabona ziva mu rusumanyenzi rw'ikuzimu zigahabwa ububasha bwo kurya abantu no kubasesereza cane.twarumvise ko ari inzige zidasanzwe zimeze nk'amafarasi y'intambara zikongera zigasa n'abantu kandi twarasomye ngo zifise umwami wazo niwe mumalayika w'ikuzimu.
name: Ivy'inzamba zikurikira

description: Twihweje icete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Filadelufiya ,ni rimwe mu mashengero abiri Yesu ataco ayagayako, n'ishengero rimeze uko Yesu agomba ko ishengero rimera mw'isi , ryari ishengero ryitondera ijambo ry'Imana. Isezerano Yesu yahaye iryo shengero ni ukurikura mw'isi ridaciye muri ca gihe c'amarushwa ahambaye azoba mu gihe c'iherezo.
name: Ivy'Ishengero ry'I Filadelufiya

description: Ishengero ry'I Lawodikiya ryari ahantu heza mu kiyaya. Umwami Yesu rero mu vyo yandikiye iryo shengero atangura avugako rimubabaza kuko ridakonje kandi ntiribire nico gituma aribwira muri aya majambo dusoma ngo:ngira nkudahwe.
name: Ivy'ishengero ry'I Lawodikiya

description: Twaganiriye ku cete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Sarudi, Yesu yabwiye iryo shengero ko ryoba maso kandi rikitondera ijambo ry'Imana. Yaravuze kandi yuko muri iryo shengero amazina y'abatanduje impuzu zabo ari make, abo nyene bake nibo basezeraniwe kugendana na Yesu bambaye impuzu zera.
name: Ivy'ishengero ry'I Sarudi

description: Twashimikiye ku cete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Tuwatira. Twarumvise ko ishengero ryari rifise ishusho ry'ishengero ry'I kiroma nk'uko rimeze nuyu musi mbere ngo ryari ishengero ryirata ukumata mu vya kera vyaba bibi vyaba vyiza ntirihinduke. Ishengero ryari ryuzuyemwo abantu benshi cane batari abakristo b'ukuri. Ivy'ubukristo vyari bisukiranye n'ivy'ubupfumu. Inyigishoo zizimiza zari nyinshi kandi ishengero ryarazakiriye rirazubakirako.
name: Ivy'Ishengero ry'I Tuwatitra

description: Twihweje ivy'ubwami bw'Imana, twarumvise ko igihe Kristo azoshinga ubwami bwiwe bw'imyaka 1000 ngaha kw'isi azoganzanya n'abamwizeye, n'abera b'Imana bo mw'isezerano rya kera bazozuka nabo baganzanye nawe hamwe na abazoba barishwe muri ca gihe c'amarushwa ahambaye bahogwa ijambo rya Kristo no kumushingira intahe. Iyo myaka 1000 satani azoyimara aboshwe kugira ngo bikunde amahoro asasagare mw'isi. Ariko nk'uko vyanditswe inyuma yiyo myaka 1000, satani azorekugwa aje kuzimiza amahanga mu gihe gito.
name: Ivy'ubwami bw'Imana

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'ubwami bwa Kristo bw'imyaka 1000. Twabonye ko ubwo bwami bwoba ari ubwami bw'amahoro butoshobora gusasagara kw'isi mu gihe satani akihafise umwidegemvyo. Ni co gituma twumvise ko satani azobanza kubohwa agakororerwa ikuzimu akamarayo imyaka 1000 kizoba ari igihe isi izoba inyotewe amahoro kuko izoba ivuye mu marushwa ahambaye n'intambara z'umurengera.
name: Ivy'ubwami bwa Kristo bw'imyaka 1000

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyo gukomvomvogwa kw'I Babuloni kubera ivyaha vyabo vyarundanye kuva na kera narindi. Twarabonye ko Babuloni hasa n'umunyavyaha w'umutunzi ahumwe amaso n'ubutunzi bwiwe , agaca yibagira yuko ivyaha vyiwe bigiye kuranduranwa nawe.
name: Ivy'ugukomvomvogwa kw'I Babuloni

description: Twganiriye kuvy'abantu babiri Yohana yeretswe bashingira intahe Imana mugabo isi ikabanka kugeza naho bicwa. Twarumvise ariko yuko impwemu z'ubugingo zivuye ku Mana zinjiye mu mivyimba yabo yari imaze indwi n'igice bagaca bahaguruka ari bazima kandi ubwonyene baciye baduga baja mw'ijuru abansi babo barorera.
name: Ivy'ugutigita kw'isi

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'umugore n'igisato c'amahero Yohana yeretswe. Twabonyeko uyo ari wa mugore yaboneka yambaye izuba nayo ukwezi kuri musi y'ibirenge vyiwe mu mutwe naho yambaye igitsibo c'inyeneyeri cumi na zibiri. Uwo mugorer rero twarumvise ko ari ihanga rya Isirayeli. Igisato amahero naco cari gihagaze imbere y'uwo mugore citeze ko avyara ngo gice kirotsa uwo mwana yari satani ariko rero Imana ntiyemeye ko ico gisato gishika kuntumbero yaco.
name: Ivy'umugore hamwe n'igisato c'amahero

description: Twaganiriye ivyo Yohana yeretswe vyerekeye ijuru risha n'isi nsha. Aho nahantu Imana yateguriye abayizera ngo baze bahabane nayo ibihe bitazoshira bari mu munezero ntangere. Aho hantu heza gutyo ni kuri wa mugwa wera ariwo Yerusalemu musha uwo Yohana yeretswe wururuka uva mw'ijuru.
name: Ivy'umugwa wera

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivya wa mumalayika w'inkomezi Yohana yerekwa. Yohana rero yabonye uwo mumalayika afise agatabo mu minwe kazinguruye kandi yarashinze ikirenge c'iburyo mu kiyaga, Ic'I bumoso naco akagishinga I musozi. Uwo mumalayika rero asemereye humvikanye imituragaro ndwi.
name: Ivy'umumalayika w'inkomezi

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvyo Yohana yeretswe vyo mw'ijuru. Ubuheruka twarumvise ingene yabonye umwagazi w'intama w'Imana yakira igitabo kimatanishijwe ishashara cari mu kuboko kw'Iyivyagiye kuri ya ntebe y'Imana. Vyabonetse ko uwo mwagazi w'intama w'Imana ariwe Yesu Kristo ari nyene ububasha.
name: Ivya wa mwagazi w'intama w'Imana

description: Twashimikiye kuvyo Yohana yeretswe bivuga kuri maraya n'igikoko gisa n'agahama. Ivyo Yohana yeretswe n'ibizoba mu gihe c'amarushwa ahambaye ayo marushwa akazoba mw'isi ishengero rimaze kuvanwa mw'isi.
name: Ivyago bizoba inzavya zimaze gutibuka

description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twarumvise vyinshi ku vyago bizoba mw'isi ishengero rimaze kuyivamwo. Twarumvise yuko ico gihe c'amarushwa n'ivyago kizoherahezwa n'ugukomvomvogwa kw'I Babuloni Yesu azorinda agaruka gushinga ubwami bwiwe asanga isi iruhijwe n'amakuba y'agakura itagira isaganirizo.
name: Ivyago vyo mugihe c'amarushwa ahambaye

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'inzavya ndwi Yohana yeretswe akabona zihabwa abamalayika ndwi. Izo nzavya zari zuzuye uburake bw'Imana. Abo bamalayika ngo Yohana yabonye ngo basohoka bava mu rusengero rwo mw'ijuru rwuguruye.
name: Ivyago Yohana yeretswe imbere y'ivyago

description: Twaganiriye ku cete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Perugamo. Ingorane z'iryo shengero ry'I Perugamo kwari ukwakira no gukomeza inyigisho zinyuranye n'ijambo ry'Imana .Iryo shengero ryarimwo abakristo benshi badahagaze neza muri Kristo.
name: Ivyandikiwe ishengero ry'I Perugamo

description: Twize ku cete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Simuruna. Twarumvise yuko ishengero ry'I Simuruna ryaranzwe no kubabazwa rizira izina rya Kristo. Twasanze rero ico cete kimwo amajambo yo kuremesha ishengero kubw'imibabaro bategerezwa gucamwo. Ico gihe cabo cari igihe c'ihamwa ry'ishengero.
name: Ivyandikiwe ishengero ry'I Simuruna

description: Twabandanije kuganira kuvyerekeye ingene Yesu yamenye ibimatanije ca gitabo c'Imana co guca amateka .Twabonye kandi ivyabaye hamenywe ica gatandatu cico gitabo.
name: Ivyerekeye inzamba ndwi

description: Twavumvise inyigisho ziri mu kiganiro ca nyuma muri izi nyigisho za bibiliya. Twarumvise ibikuru bikuru vyari muri izinyigisho harimwo ugutegurirwa kwakira Yesu Kristo agiye kugaruka. Ibikuru bikuru murizo ni Kristo Yesu, intsinzi yiwe n'ukugaruka kwiwe gutora ishengero ngo aze abane naryo imyaka n'imyaka , uwumwizera wese ntazotsindwa n'urubanza ariko azoragwa umunezero n'ubugingo bw'ibihe bitazoshira.
name: Ivyiza vy'umugwa n'ukuza kwa Yesu Kristo

description: Ubuheruka twihweje ivy'Umwami Yesu yandikiye ishengero ryo muri Efeso icishije kumuvugishwa wayo Yohana. Ico twokwibukanya nuko muri ivyo bihe ico gisagara ca Efeso cari kinini cane kandi giteye imbere muvy'ubutunzi.Cari kimeze nk'umugwa mukuru wa karere ka Aziya ntoya ariko ivyaha vyahakorerwa vyari umurengera na cane cane ivyaha vy'ubusambanyi n'ibindi vyinshi bijanye no gusenga ibigigwamana.
name: Ivyo Yesu yandikiye ishengero ryo muri Efeso

description: Twabonye igituma iki gitabo citwa Ivyahishuriwe Yohana. Iki gitabo n'ic'ubuhanuzi bw'ibizoba mu bihe bizoza. N'igitabo co gukuraho igikingiriye amaso y'abantu kugingo babone ubwiza bw'Imana bunyegejwe muri Yesu Kristo. Iki gitabo Imana yagihishuriyemwo amabanga yayo menshi cane ibicishije kuri Yohana , Yohana nawe aravyandika biba ivyacu wewe nanje.
name: Ni kuki iki gitabo ciswe ukwo?

description: Twaganiriye ivy'ubugingo butazoshira n'ijuru risha n'isi nsha aho ishengero ry'Imana rizoba mu munezero ntangere ibihe bitazoshira nk'uko Yohana abivuga mu majambo yahishuriwe ( Ivyah 21:2 )Uwo ni wa mugwa mwiza w'igitangaza abana b'Imana bazobamwo , ni wa mugwa Yesu yavuga ko ariho i muhira kwa Se aho yagiye gutegurira ikibanza abamwizeye.
name: Rupfu na kuzimu batererwa mu muriro

description: Twarabiye hamwe amajambo avuga ivy'inganji ya Kristo n'uguhona kw'abansi biwe aho azogarukira aje gushinga ubwami bwiwe bw'amahoro ngaha kw'isi.
name: Ububasha n'uguhona kw'abansi b'Imana

description: Twaganiriye ku cete candikiwe ishengero ry'I Lawodikiya, ishengero Yesu agaya kuko ridakonje kandi ntiribire. Yesu rero arabwira iryo shengero ati icompa ugakonja canke ukabira. Twarumvise ko ishengero rikonje ari iryamaze guta ukwizera ritakigiramwo urukundo kandi rititaho ijambo ry'Imana. Iryo shengero ariryo ry'akazuyazi niryo Yesu avuga ati uri mutindi mbere warafutanye, uri impumyi kandi ugenda amenya.
name: Ubupfu bw'I Lawodikiya n'impanuro Yesu yarihaye

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyo Yohana yeretswe vy'inzavya ndwi n'ivyago ndwi bizorangiza igihe c'amarushwa ahambaye. Twarabonye yuko ivyo bizoba imbere yuko vya vyago vyanyuma bisukwa mw'isi.Twabonye ko bizoba ari ivyago vyanyuma vy'amarushwa y'igihe ca nyuma.
name: Ubutumwa buzovugwa n'abamalayika

description: Twaganiriye kuvyerekeye ubwiza bw'umugwa wera ariwo Yerusalemu musha Yohana yabonye wururuka uvuye mw'ijuru. Tumvise ukuntu amatanguriro y'urugo ruzitiye uwo mugwa ari amabuye cumi nabiri y'agaciro kanini eka n'ibirimba vy'uwo mugwa vyubakishijwe imaragarita ishize inkamba.
name: Ubwiza bw'umugwa Yerusalemu musha

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvy'umugwa wera Yerusalemu musha aho Imana izovyagiza ishengero ryayo ngo bahabane nayo ibihe bitazoshira. Twarumvise yuko Yerusalemu musha atari umugwa w'amabuye n'ivyirore gusa ariko kandi hariho amazi hariho n'ibimera. Kuri uwo mugwa hazoba ivyo kurya nivyo nivyo kunywa ibihe vyose .
name: Ubwiza n'ugukayangana k'uwo mugwa

description: Twaganiriye ku vyago bizoba mu bihe vy'iherezo ishengero rimaze kuva mw'isi . Twarumvise ivy'amafarasi azoboneka azananye n'ivyago bitandukanye uko Yesu azoshishikara kumena twa dushashara tumatanije ca gitabo.
name: Yesu amena ibimatanije igitabo

description: Twaganiriye kuvyo Yohana yeretswe igihe Yesu yabandanya kumena ica gatandatu c'ishashara rimatanije ca gitabo.
name: Yesu amena igice ca gatandatu c'ishashara

description: Twumvise ingene Yohana ari mu kizinga ca Patimo yabonye ubwiza bwa Yesu. Ijwi ry a Yesu ryavuganye nawe ryamubwiye riti:ico ubona ucandike mu gitabo ukirungikire amashengero ndwi(7) ariyo :Efeso, Simuruna , Perugamo, Tuwatira, Sarudi, Firaderufiya n'I Rawodikiya.
name: Yesu asobanurira Yohana ivyo yeretswe

description: Twihweje indamukanyo ya Yohana kuri ya mashengero ndwi yandikira, yerekanye ko ubuntu n'amahoro atahandi biva atari ku Mana. Ikindi twumvise n'intango y'ingene Yohana yiyeretswe na Yesu.
name: Yesu niwe shimikiro ry'ivyanditswe

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'abamalayika babiri Yohana yeretswe bashikiriza abo mw'isi ubutumwa bwiza. Uwa mbere yavuze ati mwubahe Imana muyihimbaze kuko igihe c'amateka yayo gishitse musenge Iyaremye ijuru n'isi n'ikiyaga n'amasoko y'amazi. Uwa kabiri nawe avuga agace kivy'amateka y'Imana ati: kirakomvomvotse kirakomvomvotse Baburoni ca gisagara gihambaye cateretse amahanga yose vino niyo burake bw'ubushakanyi bwaco.
name: Yohana abona abamalayika batatu

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira ku bikoko bibiri Yohana yeretswe ,Igikoko ca kabiri cabonetse gisa n'umwagazi w'intama ariko kikavuga nk'igisato . Ico naco yabonye gihabwa ububasha bwo gukora ibitangaza kandi kikagobera abantu gusenga ca gikoko ca mbere. Ico gikoko ca kabiri naco nyene twarumvise ko naco nyene ari antikristo w'umukuru w'idini ry'ibinyoma azoshiraho rero urutonde rushasha rwo gusenga mugabo atari ugusenga Imana y'ukuri.
name: Yohana yerekwa igikoko ca kabiri

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyerekeye ishengero rinini Yohana yeretswe mw'ijuru. Abo bantu Yohana amaze kubona ari ishengero rinini, yagize amadidane mensghi yukumenya abo ari bo kuko yabopnyeko batandukanye n;ishengero. Yabwiwe ngo: aba ni abavuye muri wa mubabaro mwinshi  kandi bamesuye imvune zabo bazezesha amaraso yawa mwagazi.
name: Yohana yerekwa ishengero rinini

description: Twaganiriye kuri za nzige Yohana yerekwa akabona ziva mu rusumanyenzi rw'ikuzimu zigahabwa ububasha bwo kurya abantu no kubasesereza cane.twarumvise ko ari inzige zidasanzwe zimeze nk'amafarasi y'intambara zikongera zigasa n'abantu kandi twarasomye ngo zifiseumwami wazo niwe mumalayika w'ikuzimu.
name: Yohana yerekwa ivyerekeye inzige

description: Twari tumaze iminsi tuganira ku vyete vyandikiwe ya mashengero ndwi yo muri Aziya. Ubuheruka twararabiye hamwe intangamara y'ivyo Yohana yeretswe ihengero ry'Imana rimaze gukugwa mw'isi rikajanwa mw'ijuru.
name: Yohana yerekwa ivyo mw'ijuru

description: Twabonye ingene Yohana yeretswe Umwagazi w'Intama ahagaze ku musozi wa Siyoni ahagararanye n'abantu 144000. Abo nabo ni bamwe Yohana yabona badomwako ikimenyetso kugira ngo bazorindwe ntibahitanwe n'ivyo mu gihe c'amarushwa akomeye.
name: Yohana yerekwa umwagazi w'intama
